Asha (docs): Hey team — opening a quick thread to coordinate a tiny follow-up on the metering + tiers doc PR. I noticed the quota slab examples render oddly in the dashboard screenshots and one SDK snippet doesn't match the new header format. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523
Tom (eng): thanks, saw that. the panel id changed in infra last week so screenshots were stale. panel name is `usage_metering_v2` now.
Priya (analytics): confirmed — the backend returns a different `tier_key` for legacy customers which breaks the example query used in the doc. we should show both variants or add a note.
Asha (docs): proposal: update the SDK header snippet to show the new `X-Redwood-Account` header and add a small migration note for legacy `tier_key` behavior. also regenerate the dashboard screenshots after Tom re-exports.
Tom (eng): I can re-export tonight. quick note: export path changed, command is: `./infra/tools/export-dashboard --id usage_metering_v2 --out=docs/static/images/metering`
Derek (product): small ask — could we highlight the user impact in the PR description? e.g., "metering panel column name changed; examples updated; no user-facing quota changes". helps support triage.
l10n-bot: Locale check queued for `docs/usage/metering.md` (en -> fr, de, ja). ETA 48h.
Priya (analytics): For the SDK snippet, current example is: ```python
resp = client.list_usage(headers={"Authorization": "Bearer $TOKEN"})
``` That omits the account header and the `tier_key` mapping. New suggestion: ```python
resp = client.list_usage(headers={"Authorization": "Bearer $TOKEN", "X-Redwood-Account": "acct_123"})
# map legacy tier_key: if resp.get('tier_key') == 'legacy' -> treat as 'free'
```
Asha (docs): I'll update the snippet in the PR and add a short migration callout block. also will request the screenshots after Tom pushes.
Tom (eng): pushed export to branch `docs/4523-metering-fix` and dropped new images at `docs/static/images/metering/*.png`. I also updated the panel id reference in the sample Grafana query.
Priya (analytics): verified images — looks good. also added a note about `quota_slab` rounding behavior (it used to floor, now it rounds up for display only).
Asha (docs): awesome. action items: (1) Asha — update PR with new snippet + migration note + screenshot swap, (2) Tom — confirm export path documented in PR, (3) Priya — confirm wording on `quota_slab` rounding, (4) Derek — add product blurb in PR description. I'll ping for reviews when done. :thumbsup:
Derek (product): will add the blurb. quick Q: do we need to update the pricing calculator example too? it references slab boundaries.
Priya (analytics): yes, small change — slab boundaries unchanged, just display rounding; calculator logic unaffected. add clarifying sentence and we're good.
Asha (docs): great. tagging @l10n-bot for localization follow-up once PR merges. final note: small tweak to CI lint caught a Markdown heading level — fixed in branch too.
Tom (eng): LGTM from infra side once CI green.
Asha (docs): thanks all — I'll push the changes in the next hour and request reviews. :rocket:
